title: Morgan Stanley buys transfer agent Vinyl Equity as a tokenization building block
message_html: Morgan Stanley buys transfer agent Vinyl Equity as a tokenization building block ...
snippet: Morgan Stanley has agreed to acquire Vinyl Equity, a small SEC-registered digital transfer agent. The deal sits within Morgan Stanley at Work, the bank’s stock plan arm, which manages equity compensation for over 3,400 corporate clients including more than 70% of the top 100 unicorns by market cap.
